one_line: Print-ready photo layout tool for accurate, privacy-conscious printing.
what_it_does: Creates dimensionally exact photo sheets with configurable paper, margins, spacing, quantities, and session-oriented handling.
leverage_rationale: Structured layout parameters and repeatable print contracts make agent requests materially more precise than manipulating a general editor UI.
leverage_evidence: About describes natural-language generation of multi-photo layouts and exact physical dimensions.
execution_rationale: Coherent focused product and live demo link, but no video evidence establishes end-to-end behavior.
impact_rationale: Small photo studios have a concrete accuracy, reprint-cost, and privacy problem this addresses.
impact_evidence: About identifies ID-photo operators and millimeter-scale errors.
creativity_rationale: Practical print workflow with a clear WebMCP angle, but familiar utility category.
usability_note: Focused workflow appears easy to specify; live interaction unverified.
advance_reason: Strong use case and meaningful structured-tool delta.

one_line: Shared job-discovery workspace where an agent resolves official portals and scores openings.
what_it_does: Crawls official career portals, extracts roles, and scores them against a resume.
leverage_rationale: Resolving many company portals and extracting current roles is repetitive work where structured tools improve repeatability and shared state.
leverage_evidence: Pitch describes live shared board and WebMCP tools.
About describes portal resolution and structured extraction.
execution_rationale: Coherent workflow and live demo, but no video demonstrates the central flow.
impact_rationale: Job seekers have a clear repetitive problem and authoritative-source matching is directly valuable.
impact_evidence: About identifies incomplete aggregators and repetitive portal research.
creativity_rationale: Fresh synthesis of agent-native job research, official resolution, and resume-grounded scoring.
creativity_evidence: Human and agent work the same board.
red_flags: No video evidence; public repository absent.
standouts: Official-portal resolution is strong agent-native task.
advance_reason: High audience value and strong WebMCP fit.

one_line: Agent-assisted laboratory planning, inventory, and spatial guidance with human approval.
what_it_does: Plans rooms, stages inventory updates, checks equipment and reagents, and guides users to locations.
leverage_rationale: Structured operations over synchronized room, inventory, and spatial state with staged writes and approval are hard to reproduce reliably through UI driving.
leverage_evidence: Transcript describes 24 tools, staged batch changes, and approval.
Transcript describes spatial guidance and process tracking.
execution_rationale: 162-second transcript gives end-to-end evidence across planning, inventory, uncertainty, and guidance.
execution_evidence: Transcript covers office creation, enzyme records, checklist lookup, approval, and retrieval.
impact_rationale: Researchers have a real coordination and findability problem; linked plans, inventory, and locations address it.
impact_evidence: Transcript demonstrates inventory, expiry, uncertainty, and location guidance.
creativity_rationale: Unusually ambitious synthesis of spatial planning, inventory evidence, and approval-aware preparation.
creativity_evidence: One flow spans room layout, inventory, spatial index, and tracker.
usability_note: Editable layouts and approval checkpoints support practical use.
advance_reason: Transformative leverage and complete domain workflow.

one_line: Tracker for silent job applications and unpaid invoices with agent follow-up tools.
what_it_does: Tracks applications and invoices, marks stale records, and provides summaries and reminders.
leverage_rationale: Batch staleness detection and structured mutable records make agent participation more than UI convenience.
leverage_evidence: About lists 18 tools and stale-record actions.
execution_rationale: Coherent scope and live demo, but no visual evidence of actions.
impact_rationale: Ghosting and unpaid invoices are concrete problems for job seekers and freelancers.
impact_evidence: About cites application ghosting and passive trackers.
creativity_rationale: Clever dual-domain abstraction of being ignored with lifecycle state.
creativity_evidence: Applications and invoices share a ghosting mechanic.
usability_note: Symmetric tools suggest a learnable tracker.
advance_reason: Practical value and meaningful state leverage.

one_line: Shared ideas backlog where agents capture and humans decide what becomes work.
what_it_does: Captures and inspects ideas, proposes changes, and records human approval decisions.
leverage_rationale: Shared state with proposals, approval, and auditable decisions is more reliable than informal agent manipulation.
leverage_evidence: About describes four tools, pending review, and decision log.

impact_rationale: Capturing side ideas without breaking focus addresses a real conversational workflow problem.

creativity_rationale: Capture-versus-commit interaction is a fresh collaboration pattern.

one_line: Cooperative browser escape game where human and AI operate different abilities.
what_it_does: Uses semantic game actions exposed through Gua for a human field operative and agent-controlled systems.
leverage_rationale: Shared game state with differentiated information and abilities depends on reliable structured agent actions.
leverage_evidence: About says human and AI share one game with different abilities.
Agent uses semantic actions rather than screenshots.
execution_rationale: Alive playable demo and concrete mission are described, but no video verifies the full flow.
impact_rationale: Meaningful entertainment and a compelling demonstration for game developers, with a narrower audience.
impact_evidence: About frames playable cooperative escape and reusable automation foundation.
creativity_rationale: Role-asymmetric human-agent co-op is novel and pursued through game semantics.
creativity_evidence: Human operates field operative while AI operates control systems.
usability_note: Concrete playable URL, with browser setup friction.

one_line: Six-chapter co-op rescue puzzle game where human and agent cannot finish alone.
what_it_does: Turns discovery, structured state, errors, dynamic tools, confirmation, and orchestration into game mechanics.
leverage_rationale: WebMCP is structurally indispensable through complementary roles, dynamic tools, structured errors, confirmation, and replay.
leverage_evidence: About states game is impossible alone and maps chapters to WebMCP capabilities.
execution_rationale: 339-second demo and detailed six-chapter description provide strong evidence of coherent progression.
execution_evidence: demo video is 339 seconds; frame sheets submitted.
About details six chapters and mechanic transitions.
impact_rationale: Credible entertainment and educational/demo value for human-agent collaboration.
creativity_rationale: WebMCP primitives become interdependent puzzle mechanics; exceptionally original and ambitious.
creativity_evidence: Each chapter operationalizes a different capability.
usability_note: Chapter progression and roles support play; setup may add friction.
red_flags: No transcript; frame review was blocked by vision resource exhaustion.
standouts: WebMCP is the puzzle design language.

creativity_evidence: Same registry actions serve human and agent.

standouts: Clear niche audience and official-source orientation.

one_line: Benchmark follow-through arena where agents test playable outputs and humans judge what scores miss.

Results combine fixed checks, live tests, and human choice.

execution_evidence: About gives 22-check to seven-criteria flow and four-game shortlist.

impact_evidence: About identifies qualities scores miss and produces an acceptance plan.
